description: This Java source file defines the class NullAttributes, an implementation of the Attributes interface representing a JSON null value. It provides methods to interact with JSON attributes, mostly returning false or empty values when querying for data, and creating new attribute instances with various data types. It appears to be part of a larger JSON handling framework within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for handling null or absent attribute values.

classes.name: NullAttributes
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JSON null value, implementing the Attributes interface with methods to handle JSON attributes and interactions where the value is null.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of NullAttributes, returning it as an Attributes interface.
